card.name: Digits inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit, most often 5, in the middle of a multi-digit dose or concentration number such as 57 mg, 250 mg or 0.56 mL. It is common in dosing tables and strength lists.

modes.label: Digit in a strength
modes.description: A digit partway through a drug strength written as mg per mL.
modes.example: amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium 400 mg/<<5>>7 mg per 5 mL for oral

modes.label: Digit in a dose or table value
modes.description: A digit within a dose, volume or table value, often a decimal.

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a dose number, such as the 5 in 250 mg or 0.56 mL.
